dialogues.speaker: Yelan
dialogues.text: Are you alright? You've suddenly gone quiet. It's not like you at all.

dialogues.speaker: Yanfei
dialogues.text: Shh, we'll talk later. I'm just processing all the existing clues we have.

dialogues.speaker: Yanfei
dialogues.text: Maybe the key to our escape is hidden in some detail I've overlooked... I have to go over everything again...

dialogues.speaker: Yelan
dialogues.text: Alright, well...

dialogues.speaker: Yanfei
dialogues.text: Oh, don't worry. I won't write down anything that you told us about.

dialogues.speaker: Yelan
dialogues.text: No, I meant, if you're going to analyze the facts, count me in.

dialogues.speaker: Arataki Itto
dialogues.text: Hey, Ushi, looks like our little Lavender Melon has fallen asleep, huh? Do ya think she's dreaming?

dialogues.speaker: Ushi
dialogues.text: Moo? Moo.

dialogues.speaker: Arataki Itto
dialogues.text: Man, she looks wiped out. It's kinda hard to see her like this, I mean, most of the time she never shuts up... Ah, poor thing.

dialogues.speaker: Arataki Itto
dialogues.text: And that little dude looks done in, too. Ah, I'm kinda worried about 'em.

dialogues.speaker: Ushi
dialogues.text: Moo, moo, moo.

dialogues.speaker: Arataki Itto
dialogues.text: I sleep like this when I'm in jail? Hah! Good one. I do slumber like a king.

dialogues.speaker: Arataki Itto
dialogues.text: #{NICKNAME}!? When did you get here?

dialogues.speaker: Kuki Shinobu
dialogues.text: You don't look well. I guess things still haven't improved.

dialogues.speaker: Kuki Shinobu
dialogues.text: It's okay, you don't have to go into all the details.

dialogues.speaker: Kuki Shinobu
dialogues.text: Sometimes, I really envy the boss.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: (Xiao's eyes are tightly shut and he's not making a sound. No one has the heart to interrupt him.)
